manifest.name: Wyoming TTS
manifest.description: Connect Wyoming protocol TTS servers to Music Assistant for text-to-speech.

user.title: Connect a Wyoming TTS server
user.description: Enter the address of your Wyoming TTS server.

server_uri.label: Server address
server_uri.description: The address of your Wyoming TTS server: host:port

voices.label: Voice filter
voices.description: Limits which programs and voices are exposed to Music Assistant. Leave empty to expose all. Patterns may use * wildcards.

voice_languages.label: Language filter
voice_languages.description: Limits which languages are exposed to Music Assistant. Leave empty to expose all.

output_format.label: Output format
output_format.description: Audio format to store and serve synthesized clips in.

synthesis_timeout.label: Synthesis timeout
synthesis_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the server to synthesize a message, before the synthesis fails

errors.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server. Check the address and ensure the server is running.
errors.no_tts_programs: The server does not advertise any TTS programs or voices.
errors.no_voices: The language and voice filters do not match anything advertised by the server. Change the voice or language filters in the plugin's options.
errors.voice_not_found: The configured voice is no longer available on the server.
errors.synthesis_timeout: The server did not synthesize the message within {0} seconds. Check the Wyoming server's log for errors or increase the synthesis timeout in the plugin's options.
